answer: Each identity must lease a berth at the shared wharf and prove real cargo throughput every epoch: verified useful work logged by the harbour master. An idle island of fakes pays rent with nothing to show, so at its nadir the attacker ledger is all cost, no revenue. Rent is $6 per identity per epoch, rising $2 per epoch of tenancy, so ten fakes cost $60 and $20 more each epoch.
